name: Large-Scale General Purpose Ground Truth Database
description: A methodology, annotation tool, and benchmark dataset providing ground-truth annotations at large scale for general-purpose evaluation of recognition tasks.
evaluation_method: accuracy / mean Average Precision (mAP) / IoU depending on the specific recognition task
typical_sota_score: varies by task and model; no single consolidated SOTA (unknown)
notes: Large-scale annotation resource and tooling; task definitions and metrics are task-dependent. Older dataset that has been superseded in some subdomains by more recent benchmarks; not an LLM benchmark.
